text: 'La gran cura' is a macro-exhibition. 'La gran cura' is a scavenger hunt. 'La gran cura' is the largest curatorial project Unfunny_Curator has done to date.

This project is an expanded publication and a scavenger hunt around Agramunt where participants are asked to collect texts from various points of the town. They are room texts written for establishments such as a hairdresser's, a hardware shop, a church or a cemetery, proposing to read these spaces the same way as contemporary art exhibitions and opening a debate on the language and discourse used in the sector.
Within the exhibition Tot tombant, convoco by Laura Albajar, Enric Marzà and Unfunny_Curator, the result of the creation residency Lo Niu 2025.
